planets.name: AU Mic c
planets.description: Transiting planet of AU Mic with a 18.9-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: AU Mic c was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around AU Mic. Its orbit and size follow Mallorquín et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
